name: shiksha-slides-tutorial
title: Explore an interactive slide deck

chapters.caption: 1. Open a course and request a concise lesson deck.
2. Open the generated slides beside your conversation.
3. Browse the lesson and reveal its speaker notes.
4. Compare two resistances while voltage stays at 6 V.
5. Start presentation mode for a focused walkthrough.
6. Finish with the takeaway, then return to the same slide.

description: Request an original Ohm's-law deck, browse real slides and speaker notes, and present a worked comparison before returning to the course.
capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
